players.product: merchant power supplies / power shelves (FlexPower) for AI racks

quarterly_data.signal: Flex completed its acquisition of EPC Power on October 14, 2026 (8-K release; bridge-loan financing excluded): EPC Power, a provider of intelligent power conversion solutions for data center and grid applications, is now part of Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment. CEO Revathi Advaithi: EPC Power adds differentiated power conversion and grid-forming technology to Flex's capabilities across power, cooling and compute, and together they can help customers address the growing power demands of AI infrastructure with more efficient, resilient and integrated solutions.
